# Branch: c/exciting-tesla-v88akp

Tracking branch for **IMPT-004** — `publish`: Farrier puts the local
project folder on its instance. It creates the repository on the forge,
pushes the folder's existing history, and sets `origin` to the instance's
git-over-SSH URL, so a project with no forge behind it reaches a working
remote without going through GitHub or GitLab first.

See `docs/functional-requirements.md` § IMPT and `docs/status.json`.

This file exists for conductor tracking and can be deleted once the PR merges.
